en: Colorized historical postcard view of a grand neoclassical spa-town square. In the center stands a large ornate building labeled "HABERLAVES HAUS" (likely Haberl's Haus) with three stories, arched entrance and balconies. In front is a landscaped garden with paths, low hedges, flowerbeds, and a sculpted fountain. Surrounding the square are multi‑story hotels and townhouses; two buildings at the right and far left are marked as hotels. Forested hills rise in the background. The printed caption at the top reads in German about the fountain and square in Marienbad.
